They did not understand what they were doing while standing as propagandists of Narayana Guru. To function in that state, one needs a tendency that is attached to it in some way. To put it into practice and reach the people, there must be an idea slightly ahead. This idea will not just be useful like that. As an example for that, Narayana Guru has said a word:

[GV3:P0638] The lamp that shines when the Tripudi (triad) is destroyed

[GV3:P0639] Will not be attained by a deceitful Yati-

[GV3:P0640] Remember this secret statement of the Upanishad

[GV3:P0641] Whoever justifies that a course of karma that has come down to this day does not exist, is certainly a pseudo-ascetic. The person who performs actions must definitely have the understanding that even if the gross body is discarded, the subtle body remains with us. This is an essential matter. What proof should we give for that? I have closely known many of the people who call themselves believers of Sree Narayana Guru. I will say with certainty that they cannot do this. I am saying this standing on a truth I realized from efforts over a long time.

[GV3:P0642] How have we understood the aspect of the manes (Pitru)? Today, we often depend on the lineages of Devas and Rishis to correct the aspect of the manes. Many people have exerted themselves and made others exert for the acquisition of knowledge. One of them is Gandhiji. Another is Rabindranath Tagore. But the aspect of the manes could not be corrected. The karma that has come through the vigilance of our ancestors is contained in the divinity resting in the Trimurti system. That is, Shaktheyam, Saivam, Vaishnavam—or Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva.

[GV3:P0643] Question: Does Guru mean that one should move forward by understanding where and how the mistake happened?

[GV3:P0644] Guru: Yes, that is the solution for it. I can only give you an introduction to that. Other than that, I have no path like Siddhi (miraculous powers) to offer. Under the guise of the path of Siddhi, many like Raja Yoga, Hamsa Yoga, Chandrika Yoga, and Hatha Yoga have emerged. But none of these have improved the land to date.

[GV3:P0645] We know that Sanatana Dharma has departed from the people and what supports have been given from the presence of God to repeatedly restore it. That support was given through Sree Krishna. The history is that Sree Krishna was removed from India without being retained, bringing another aspect, and Dwarka was submerged. Since then, so many great souls have come, so many Guru lineages, the Parayi petta panthirukulam, the eighteen Siddhars ٹ and numerous great men known through reading and writing have come. One of them is Rabindranath Tagore. Vivekananda is a disciple of an unlettered person. We are trying to establish that by giving a great price. Only by seeing the soul form of these great souls who came after Sree Krishna can we understand what it is like. Its benefit lies in visualizing their soul form. What is the use of simply singing Kilippattu without seeing it?

[GV3:P0646] There is a knowledge here that has seen the soul forms of those great souls without any distinction of caste, religion, or class; that is, we have reached a path that reveals this soul form. That is the path here. The guidance provided by crores of souls—Gods and Goddesses, and the paths traversed through Siddhi principles and Yoga ways—is present here. I am conveying a knowledge to state beyond any shadow of a doubt that none of this has reached complete fruition.

[GV3:P0647] I only know how to speak like this. Mine is not a way of speaking in any other manner. There is also evidence here to prove this to you. You will get that evidence only if you love and believe. There is no other karma here. It is not I who should give that proof. Someone else has to see and say what this knower of the soul is.

[GV3:P0648] Question: Is Guru saying that one must reach there through Karma Yoga?

[GV3:P0649] Guru: Yes. The one who sees in whom, where, and how the karma rests, is the one who should say it. The Guru who stands as a witness to that must be capable there. Did you understand that?

[GV3:P0650] Question: Am I capable of saying anything?

[GV3:P0651] Guru: Still, we have some knowledge, don't we? We have at least a little discernment to say what is truth and what is untruth. The evidence for that is the families who have come here as believers today. Over five thousand families come here who are able to say this is the truth. But one cannot say that there is even a single family that lives fully absorbing that truth. There are many families among them who are followers of other religions. The courage of these people of other religions comes from Jesus and other prophets. If they don't understand it through the courage of this experience, they will start saying everything else is bad, that is not complete, this alone is complete. With that, everything will be ruined. This is what I am saying. Narayana Guru has said it in one word: Everything that exists is indeed there. But, it should be useful for the seeker of philosophical truth.

[GV3:P0652] Who stands, where, and how in the aspect called the Guru rising in principle. This is the subject. This is beyond thought. Do not apply intellect, do not bring it into thought. Human intellect has a limit. If pushed beyond that, it will go crazy.

[GV3:P0653] When the time comes, we need someone in front of us based on our predestination. Otherwise, it will be lost. Whatever is done, it will go in vain. This is why I say to bring these great souls in front. Shouldn't we see what all they bore? No matter how sick someone is, if they come to me, I will arrange a setting for that. Someone among you must see it as an experience—I am not saying in the sense that everyone will see. We can develop this path through the goodness of this Kali Yuga. But we have been made to believe that Kali is bad. Kali is never bad. What I am saying now is proof of that. If Kali were bad, this would not happen; Kali is what is guiding us. Unless one understands that Kali is the best time that guides us in every way, no matter who does what, they will not be saved. It is that lack of understanding that prompted Gandhiji to try to bring Ramarajya. There is a notion that this will not happen in Kali. But that is the delusion created by Puranas and Epics.

[GV3:P0654] The Puranas and Epics have completed three phases. The fourth phase is completed in Kali. Man was brought repeatedly to complete the dharma of Kali. But it was not established here. It still continues to function up to the fourth part. It was also judged that the fourth part is useless. The statement that the fourth part is useless has been a mistake since the time it was made. That is, by holding onto the Trimurti state, three eras were completed. For the fourth era to be completed, Kali must be set right. That is part of knowledge.

[GV3:P0655] The first era proved that truth is indeed truth. That is exactly why it is called Satyayuga. Satyayuga functioned as Satyayuga. After that, up to where did this Manu lineage, or the Trimurti lineage after leaving the Manu lineage, function? This must become clear to us. Otherwise, what is the use of just giving a justification and making do? It is not I who should say this; someone among you should say it, and through you, share with the world a curiosity for the lineage to take it up and act upon it.

[GV3:P0656] Question: That curiosity should be cultivated.

[GV3:P0657] Guru: Yes. For that to come, shouldn't we know what was wrong and what was right in past events? We must know what capability the Manu lineage had and how that capability was lost. Without knowing that, the Trimurti lineage cannot be rejected. This is the knowledge here.

[GV3:P0658] When the Trimurti phase came, Kali was described in a way that made it seem entirely bad. How will these negative aspects called Kali be taken up and removed? If we say let it go on without doing that, how will it go? What is this flaw, what is its remedy—this can only be understood through experience. There must be someone to show this experience in front of you.

[GV3:P0659] I am stating an experience. After I experienced it, it became impossible to escape from it. Ever since this started, it has come as an adversity. But there is no escaping it. Therefore, I was experiencing it by stomping, kicking, knowing, familiarizing, and enduring it. There is no other way. There is no one else to tell me. But when this was reached, everyone came.

[GV3:P0660] Just stating this experience is not enough. Saying that what existed before does not exist is also not enough. The flaws and merits of what exists must be highlighted. Only then can one say that what is starting is correct. This is the subject. That karma, which becomes personally convincing and attains dharma in action, must reach you. For it to become personally convincing, one must be convinced of the recurring stages of the life of the great souls who have come so far. Growing from there, one must reach the part called fulfillment.

[GV3:P0661] Fulfillment of what? Those standing with me know what the fulfillment is of. But they have not been able to be convinced of it. Continuous effort and such awareness are not strictly required for that. It is enough to have love and respect for me.

[GV3:P0662] On one occasion, I went to Maruthwamala. Five people were with me. One of them was looking at a description in a vision. Then he asked me for advice. I wrote it down and gave it to him. That man had also gone to my Guru. But that is a different method. Mine is a different method. But it should not be denied. I have not denied it. Where else could I go after denying it! But he stood up to that part and then moved away. Those with experience will understand if they think a little this way and that.

[GV3:P0663] After seeing the description, that man became an experiencer. After that, he thought about getting married. Having thought so, he came to me. But he didn't mention that matter. He spoke about what he saw in the vision. When I understood what he had seen, I felt I should not get close to this person anymore. This is a huge trouble. Since then, I haven't been close to him. If there is conscience, truth, and love, one will get this. And that too, not for everyone. The cyclic capacity of the Yugas must have reached the soul in an atomic nature. Only such people will get this. This soul must be an authority at least to the size of an atom. Intellect, capability, or efficiency are not the criteria for gaining authority. As mentioned earlier, it is a soul where the cyclic capacity of the Yugas has reached at least trivially. With that cyclic capacity, one must see the nature and karma of the Pitru. Under what, where, how, and up to where does the Pitru stand, what is the flaw in the karma performed by worshipping and causing to worship, where did it go and attain the form of a soul, where has it taken root? There is no point in just saying Pitru and dismissing it. Deliverance must be given to it.

[GV3:P0664] We know the story of Agastya's effort and hardship to give deliverance to the Pitru. If Agastya had to experience such difficulty, how much more difficulty would ordinary people have! It is said that through Agastya's capacity for action, four people like Sri Rama could be given birth. If one has the authority of the cyclic capacity of the Yugas, that will definitely happen.

[GV3:P0665] In this cyclic distinction here, the network of Siddhis has absolutely no place. If you are guided by networks of Siddhis, you will be mesmerized by Siddhi and cease to exist. Among us, so much about Yoga Vidya, Karma Vidya, and Jnana Vidya has been talked about and the essence of Vedanta has been written down. Nothing is to be achieved with this. Therefore, this will be set right only if you bring this through your successors, the children, in a way that convinces you.

[GV3:P0666] By practically studying all four Vedas, studying what the karma of the four time periods is, and finding no salvation in it, the Upanishads came ٹ One must remember the secret of the Upanishadic sayings. So, it will be sufficient only if one sees what the secret of this Upanishad is. There are no other justifications for this. It is the lamp that shines after transcending the Triputi. Science and consciousness that are like dramatic acting—if all these are bundled and spoken, they will not enter the minds of the people. The secret of the Upanishads cannot enter like that. A color is specified for each of these. In the Narayanopanishad, this is stated a bit more. Those who speak of color must see it. It is not enough to just see the Deva and the Devi. Seeing this, one must be able to save at least one family by seeing what the destruction, survival, and description of this Deva, Devi, and Pitru (manes) are.

[GV3:P0667] Question: If one family is saved, will its benefit extend to other families as well?

[GV3:P0668] Guru: Yes, that was just said. Regarding what is seen here, they themselves must see and say. The same application holds for Socrates as well. I am not saying it that way either. You must see how such great souls and thinkers were on the path traversed by your predecessors. Socrates is highly placed among thinkers. Experiencers are of a different kind. People like Nostradamus and Aurobindo Ghosh are experiencers. Otherwise, if you think based on what someone said, this will not work. We must see that all this is true.

[GV3:P0669] Question: While assimilating all this, one must reach the first conclusion.

[GV3:P0670] Guru: We can say that in our thoughts, but it is not possible. This must definitely be confirmed by realizing it through experience.

[GV3:P0671] Question: Is this possible just by us hearing someone's experience?

[GV3:P0672] Guru: No. His experience is according to the magnitude of his soul. It must be thought about at least up to the point of differentiating between those with intellect and those without. Would it be right to take a fool and give him the position of the most intelligent person? This is entirely about authority. [GV3:P0673] There are more than five hundred people to say this is the truth in this manner. It doesn't mean they have all attained the truth. If their course of action is not right, even they will go wrong. I tell this to everyone. They themselves must understand it and behave accordingly. My thought is, what can be achieved by just creating a situation to prove this is right?

[GV3:P0674] Those who have not known, seen, or heard me come here after seeing me in visions. Some ten to sixteen people come like that. It's not our language, not our dress. For that, what is done first is Pitru Shuddhi (purification of the manes).

[GV3:P0675] When Pitru Shuddhi is performed, five purifications take place along with it. It is not like knowing from the Vedas. Pitru Dharma, Gruha Dharma, Deva Dharma, Dana Dharma, Atma Dharma. These five Dharmas must descend from a household. The ones through whom it descends like that are the men and women in our homes. It is being proven here that we can achieve this without the help of ideological paths. I never think that I can call ten ascetics here, give them advice, and get them to do this. Capability or incapability is not what is required here. The truth is about how to reach the part of the goodness of the mind.

[GV3:P0676] You might know many great people who are your contemporaries. I am not saying all this is bad. But it won't work out with that. This is my experience. This is said for human thought. It is the duty of those yet to come and others as well to think, know, and inform. This is being said so that they and you can understand it as one. Let the realization of it through experience come according to their respective eligibilities. This is a knowledge that man needs to reflect upon.

[GV3:P0678] Guru Jayanthi Edition

[GV3:P0679] September 1999

[GV3:P0680] Life is the Recitation of Vedas in the Soul

[GV3:P0681] When considering the knowledge of the land, home, and family members where I was born, it is certainly difficult to say that something like this grew out from there. Because their knowledge and familiarity are like that. The knowledge passed down from them is of no use to us for anything. However, there is another matter. It is a special quality of that land. Speaking of the special quality, its name is Chandiroor. The land (Ooru) in the shape of the moon (Chandra). It seems like such a name was deliberately given to this land. But the nearby places are also 'Oorus'. The nature of this place is not attributed to any of those Oorus. If asked what is the reason for Chandiroor to have this nature, we must believe that it is God's intention from the early times. What is the reason for this?

[GV3:P0682] Religious theoreticians know how long it has been since prophetic religions started. There is a lack of people to say what the knowledge, familiarity, and degradation of the Hindu religion are like. That deficiency has affected all religions. In any religion, it is natural for the successors to follow the path taken by the predecessor.

[GV3:P0683] The source of India or Asia is the imagination of the Rishis. What is the reason for such a concept to arise? We are not certain. If we look back, tremendous ups and downs have happened not just for India, but for the entire world. India is at the forefront when it comes to culture. One cannot even imagine in what all ways that culture was torn apart and to which all paths it was led. It has gone that far away. If your desire is to change this now, Chandiroor itself must become eligible for it. That land's eligibility must become an eligibility according to God's will. Otherwise, if it becomes the eligibility of individual persons, castes, or religions, that eligibility will cease to be the eligibility of that land or that person.

[GV3:P0684] Out of the twenty-eight Chaturyugas in this (seventh) Manvantara, twenty-five Chaturyugas have changed and functioned. If asked where the harm caused by this change has reached, it has reached a state in a way none of us can think of, in a way we cannot even imagine. Let that be however it may. How should we take the occasion we are born into today? This should be our focus. We should not waste time singing about what has passed and what is yet to come as its continuation.

[GV3:P0685] We must definitely believe that the time we are born in is truly blessed. We must live in the light of that belief. When we say belief, it is the embodiment of love. Or it is a path of truth that can unite with God. In such a path, it is not right for each of us to turn against each other and fight, or to say that mine, yours, and others' are not right, and only someone else's is right. If someone says that no one else's is right, it is wrong, and only mine is right, no one will be able to accept it. For us, there is no place for such talk. Religious theoreticians have not been able to impart this. When I tell you a truth, I wish you to listen carefully and implement it in your life to see the results.

[GV3:P0686] What is called God? It is the karma where the five senses, five sheaths, and five elements work together with the soul and spirit. This is a reality without the distinctions of male, female, small, big, caste, religion, or class. When this reality was somewhat stretched and summarized and presented to eminent scholars, they pushed it into scientific consciousness. What is called scientific consciousness is not modern science. It is the history belonging to the six Shastras, four Vedas, and such epics. How can we lift this history up? There is no need for us to lift any of this. You are not the authorities to lift this up. Because our ancestors are not those who lived their lives copying it. What you should do now is that you and your children must achieve this without perishing due to casteism and without destroying the Vedas through religion.

[GV3:P0687] We know that any religion and any caste that has worked for the awakening of man is for the upliftment of the human race. But the scholarly mindset cultivated all these religions and executed manipulative tricks to belittle them all. What is that manipulative trick? We have heard, haven't we, our parents go to a school or a religious institution that imparts education and plead, "Please open the eyes of my child." Does the child have no eyes? The child has eyes. Then what needs to be opened? It is the eye of his heart that must be opened. But that cannot be achieved by this person we approach. Then where should this be addressed?

[GV3:P0688] What should parents be, as far as this child is concerned, even before birth? Without getting entangled in studying castes and religions, without class hatred, how should we absorb the journey of truth, what all did our ancestors do, what do we have left to do now, how can we handle things to cultivate the achievements willed by God through us—parents must understand this with pain, communicate it, and according to their capability, impart it to the children. But it cannot just be taken and given to children like that. Then how can it be given?

[GV3:P0689] First, understand a karma we have. All the knowledge we have received till today is the complete form of human effort. Through what was it first received? Through Sanatana Dharma, or Manusmriti. So we have a historical truth that came through Manu's Smriti. But what is the use of talking about Manusmriti without letting us know what Manu is?

[GV3:P0690] Manu's karma is the resurrection of man. Manu is the primeval Guru. Who knows that such Gurus existed in India? Do Hindus know? No one knows this at all. It is this knowledge that needs to be brought to light. What all must we bring into our course of action to illuminate this knowledge? Do not assume that we will get any benefit or divine help if we start arguing, proving, and winning it in any way. If such a shortcoming has occurred in the ancestors, we must remove that shortcoming, create a path, and guide the children through that path. We should view the entire lineage of preceding Gurus and prophets with the love of God. Then we must take upon ourselves the failures that have occurred in it till today. Teach this to the children.

[GV3:P0691] How many years of history do we need to retrieve? We must have an account of the eons for that. Calculating twelve thousand divine years for a Chaturyuga, seventeen lakh years have passed since the time of Sri Rama. If this calculation has gone wrong, where did it go wrong, and why was it made to go wrong? Each of us is a point of this karma that has gone wrong. Standing firmly in this truth which is a human right, we must carefully observe, act, and make the future generations act, without ruining them by speaking of caste and religious hatred. This is the greatest karma and duty that parents must indispensably perform. Why should children who do not know caste and religion be informed of it, aren't women the ones giving birth here—when such a notion is brought up, they immediately fall into the two castes of male and female. Divided into classes like this, then escalating and ruining it, we are all residual figures of an acquired habit.

[GV3:P0692] Before the Hindu religion, which claims that its essence lies within itself, asserts this right, it must know what its history is. Why should one who doesn't know this become the spokesperson for that dharma? What do those who have accepted the prophetic religion know about it? Despite struggling so much, these historical theoreticians haven't been able to understand what harm has befallen that history. Every opportunity you have received is arranged for you by God. In what manner? During the time of Sree Krishna, Sree Krishna said for us: Whatever aspects our ancestors worshipped, see all of them in me. When he says in me, it refers to this color of the sky. The sky has a blue color. But the sky has no color. It appears blue due to the depth of the sky. If that is Sree Krishna's color, it appears due to the depth of that soul. There is no Pitru, Deva, Rishi, Sanyasi, or devotee who has a course of karma capable of merging into this color. Many great ancestors have seen, known, agonized over this, and stated it for us.

[GV3:P0693] 'Udalodu poyora parameshande parartha bhakthano' (Is it the supreme devotee of the Supreme Lord who went with his physical body)—this is said about Ramalinga of Vadalur. It is said that Ramalinga of Vadalur went with his physical body. But he did not go with his physical body. He went into the room and was not seen again. When they entered the room, only a lamp was burning. This is why he is known as Jyothi Ramalinga. What is the difficulty for this state to come to you? We must think like this. When great souls come in each era, it is customary for them to look at their predecessors to see what they should do. The method of a head of a family, a party member, or a ruler is also the same. They look at what their predecessors have done, discuss its rights and wrongs a bit, and then take it up and do the same themselves. They have nothing else to bring forward. Similarly, we also say and study this. We not only say and study it but also firmly stand by the action of how to take it. We must see how the distress occurred in the complete form of the karma we firmly stood by. If a great soul comes before us, he must look at the history of his follower from the beginning and tell him, 'You are like this, and you must complete it like this.' A problem has occurred where religious theoreticians cannot step down to this level, nor can they climb up into it. In that position, what have these theoreticians done? They got caught up in the broken thought that God must come through my caste, through my religion, through my class. However, you should not think that this line of thought has completely broken down. Because you are putting immense effort into it and lying crushed within it. To escape from there, your this karma must be shattered.

[GV3:P0694] Who can shatter this for you? At the very least, one must reach the position of Buddha, Jain, Nabi, or Guru Nanak and then come and tell you. Someone who has not even reached that position should not give guidelines to break this karma; it will bring harm. If such guidelines are given, not only will he go downwards, but he will also be unable to accept that prophet. Because of that inability to accept, what all is happening in front of us today?

[GV3:P0695] There is no one to take this up and say it in this state. It is not possible to say it using history or science. It is said, "Sasthirangal shathakodi kattalum uthavathu, uthavathu, uthavathu" (Even if one learns a hundred crore sciences, it is of no use, no use, no use). Where did the science that stands useless like this go wrong? How did this kind of destruction happen to Divine Justice? Such a destruction should not happen to Divine Justice, should it? We need such a thought. That thought might become the reason to correct ourselves. There must be an idea to come to such a correction. An element that fits the state of truth that evaluates everything and connects it to one. One must be able to connect the disconnected forms of variations in whatever our ancestors have done to one, purify and adorn it, and merge it into that after adorning it. This is the Guru. No one should think they can just say something and merge it, or study the Vedas and Shastras and merge it; it will not happen.

[GV3:P0696] There are plenty of hardships that have come upon us due to our inability. It is not just in education, wealth, and nobility, but it has filled all individuals, and the prophet lineages or other lineages we boastfully grow into have turned into a stage of ignorance. The offering of it to God is not happening. But this is a time when God stands compassionate for us. We can certainly offer it to God. For that, men, women, small and big alike have certain things to do without going bad. Whatever absurdities of the caste system our ancestors played out by being in various prophet lineages, we must see them with our eyes, grieve in our minds, and attain a maturity to ask ourselves: what should I do now, where should I submit it, what should I do for my children. An introduction is needed to reach this maturity.

[GV3:P0697] All religious theoreticians have the acquaintance of Darshana (vision). But the knowledge we lack is how far these religious theoreticians have envisioned. For one who realizes the vision in five states—Jagrat (waking), Swapna (dreaming), Sushupti (deep sleep), Turiya, and Turiyatita—the virtue of the soul is the dharma of seeing and verifying how the five sheaths, five senses, and five elements function together by observing the life-force. If the aspect of vision is explained in this manner, you won't be able to grasp it. Then what should be done? You should not reject anything you have accepted so far. If you reject it, you won't be able to move forward. Without rejecting them, submitting them all where they need to be submitted, purifying them, removing all the embarrassment from them, it is a life of recitation of the Vedas of complete spirituality—discriminating that the material and the spiritual are not two. It is because we do not know that this is our life that so many things have happened to us. All that must be changed by mutually enduring and forgiving.

[GV3:P0698] Our land is Bharatam. Some think it got the name Bharatam because Bharata ruled it, but that is not correct; it is a scholarly opinion. So what is the truth? This Bharata came after so many Bharatas had passed. We don't need to know all this, do we? Which Bharata is this? Are you talking about the ones born as these four people? What all histories and created stories existed here even before that? So many eras have passed since Sree Krishna. What all happened within these five thousand years. So many great souls came. The count is that two thousand four hundred and forty-four Gurus or prophets have come. If we disrupt this count and falsely attribute it to someone else, what will we become, what will our way of life become? We will drift away from the truth. Understanding this reality, each one of you is the complete form of a contribution to be given to the land, country, and the world through you. If you do not believe this and act upon it, we will destroy ourselves, but no harm will come to the truth.

[GV3:P0699] What we have got is Kali (Yuga). Everyone has been made to hear that Kali is bad. If Kali is not good, how will we take it forward? What is the use of us living in this time? Kali is good. It is good in every way. Freedom in every aspect, religious freedom, class freedom—everything has already come. Now, which way should this freedom be guided? Who should we be in that action? If we are to ascend in such a dharma, what all tasks must we accomplish? This should be our goal.

[GV3:P0700] Regarding me, there is a knowledge I received as God. That is what I am conveying to you. A negative aspect of the karma committed by my predecessors and yours stands spread all over the world as barbarism. You can firmly believe that the knowledge to correct this barbarism has been given as God. You should not assume that I am saying what I have in my hands. I am saying this so that you may have a great sense of agency that needs to stand in harmony with your own dharmas and karmas.

[GV3:P0701] I worked at Sivagiri for seventeen years. I didn't get even a part of the vision from there. I know many people speak and teach the aspect of vision. I have also tried following that. None of it proved fruitful. I had the experience through a great soul wandering as a fakir, known as a Pattani. With the effort of twenty-nine years after having the experience, I could know what the true path to God is. Do not think this is yesterday's effort or today's effort. Just understand that when it was known, it was a very difficult one.

[GV3:P0702] No religious theoretician has the authority to say that what we have been worshipping does not exist. Give deliverance to it; if it is entitled to liberation, give it liberation; instead of polluting the rest and leaving it in the atmosphere, destroy it for the good of the atmosphere. That is the decorum for it. This is the activity happening in Santhigiri. You must try to do this and make it yours. For that, the most minimal beginning has been completed here. You must understand this completed task as the completed karmic course of a personality.

[GV3:P0703] Karma means actions done with words, mind, and body. All that must be appropriate for you too. There is no need for you to look into sin or merit. There is no need to work with honesty (in the worldly sense). A time is coming right behind when the goodness of that work will be accepted not just by this land, not just by this country, but by all people belonging to all Guru lineages. You must see and know that. It is impossible to think that everyone alive today will see it. Yet, everyone will be able to be convinced of it—that there is something in this, and we are going after what is real. You should not follow this without maintaining the love, respect, and certainty that we will never deviate from it. That is a danger. A similar danger occurred in the beginning. Beginning means twenty-five Chaturyugas ago. I have told you numerous times that this mistake is the cause of all the dangers seen today. How will the reciters of the Vedas speak about this mistake? How will the theoreticians speak? Who can speak of it, keeping what measure?

[GV3:P0704] If a prophet or a religious theoretician comes, they can only speak of the influence of the time allotted to them and leave. They cannot say anything more than that. Those who come later might say what will happen after that. Even our greatest theories are only up to this much. Let us get whatever it may be through whichever path. You must understand that this is the course of karma that saves our predecessors, sees what the merit and sin in that soul are, and resolves it.

[GV3:P0705] This is accessible not just to our children and mothers, but to all people who follow customary practices. You can definitely take this up. I have never deceived you by speaking of things you cannot take up. I told you how you can take this forward and who you must become. You must ensure that your male or female children do not perish by drifting apart in the name of caste and religion, but make the God, divided and kept as each one's own, available to everyone equally. This is a huge effort. We must be able to reach at least the imaginative realm of this effort. The knowledge to reach there is available here. I have never told you knowledge that is not here. You can definitely harmonize with this. People belonging to all religious doctrines are here. That is the proof of it.

[GV3:P0706] The method here is not what is taught in the existing ashram doctrines. It is a method that tells you to do this and that in the path shown by God. About five hundred people had experiences in that. There are those who have moved forward quite a bit. This is not a job for earning rice. Not just rice, but it is the task of becoming the authority over the Navagrahas by acquiring gold, land, and everything, and removing all karmic doshas.

[GV3:P0707] While the earth is revolving like this with the sun and the moon, the historical truth of telling the time at any moment lies here. Through that historical truth, after explaining how many times it has to revolve to make a year, a month, and a date—it must have shown at least one divine year in it. For a human, a month is two fortnights. The bright fortnight and the dark fortnight. Thus, with twelve months, a year was determined, and with three hundred and sixty-five years, one divine year was determined. You must carefully preserve without losing this truth that God imparted to you for our children to cross all these years and think whether there is any reason or meaning for this time and this merit.

[GV3:P0708] Seeing the karma completed on a small scale here, perform a primal karma like Gotra Shuddhi (lineage purification) to produce whatever you can from it and make it your own. Keep it as your contribution to the world. An opportunity will come sometime to give it to the world through you. Let an understanding of taking and giving whatever you need remain equally inside and outside you. That goodness is to be attained by hearing, knowing, and practicing. You must do it. These words of mine are my love for you, up to the limit of my knowledge. However much effort you put into taking this up, let it become something ordained by God for your welfare. Do not pollute it with caste and religion and ruin it.

[GV3:P0712] How the Trimurti System Originated

[GV3:P0713] When I started the ashram, I received an intimation: you should think a little about your life. I didn't understand what it was back then. I asked my Guru, Pattani Swami. He said, 'I have only received two things. You will get the rest. One, it's not enough to seek only the spiritual; two, you will have to change your ascetic attire.'

[GV3:P0714] Here, prayers and rituals were performed thirty-four times in the name of Poortheekaranam (Fulfillment). On the seventh day after starting the prayer for the thirty-fourth time, an intimation was received to place a Kumbham. For four years after receiving the intimation, there was no capability to do this. In the fifth year, it was done on a small scale. This has shown us a nature that acts and resolves through the five elements, the five senses, and the five sheaths for the sake of humanity. This karma is performed here by bringing a change to the customary practices of such karmas conducted till date. Not everyone gets this authority.

[GV3:P0715] This is a path where matters of Siddhi cannot be handled at all. Siddhi is not Jnana. Even those accompanying me have insisted that some Siddhis should be shown. I asked the Brahmam if I may do it. I also got permission to do it. After a short while, it was also said that it is not good. Thus, stopping it right there is the history here.

[GV3:P0716] A detailed explanation of placing the Kumbham was revealed a few years ago. It was said that it must be done with the firm resolve that our lineage must strongly possess the capability to bear this. Among Hindus, the Trimurti worship system is strongly prevalent. At one time, this stood strengthened to the point where it was indispensable. When it was hidden under the Varnasrama Dharma, it failed to take root in the soil of Kerala. It was with the advent of British rule that the Varnasrama Dharma suffered damage and wore away. This damage has not completely vanished even today. Theoreticians have kept this in a way that it doesn't become known outside. Although freedom was achieved through the political thinkers who followed this, with that benefit, it hasn't been possible to touch good things until now. It can only be brought about through children with innate aptitude. It must be understood based on a family and taught to the land and the children. A lot of effort has to be put in for that. Because the impurity in the manner of the land is hidden within the people.

[GV3:P0717] All the forms of worship that have come to the world, and all the past Acharyas and their achievements have been shown here. From the very beginning of Kali, Gurus were born for this purpose. It was later revealed that the fulfillment karmas mentioned earlier were performed to give birth to children who are free from the baseness of a certain stage of Kali. Even I was not informed of its actual meaning. If I knew it directly, arrogance would arise. Therefore, the Brahmam made it happen without letting me know.

[GV3:P0718] Nothing will happen without the gross, the subtle, the cause, and the effect. The ones who must emerge as the most eligible are the householders. They have become corrupted along with the world. However, the form of truth is being proven through the householders who believe here. There are also householders here today who have fully understood it. Even experienced householders who receive the divine word are here today. But due to a lack of innate aptitude (vasana), they are unable to affirm and do this. Only the Brahmacharis will get the affirmation.

[GV3:P0719] As mentioned earlier, when the intimation to place the Kumbham was received, it could not be placed as there were no circumstances for it. This can be done as an offering for the incurable diseases of the people. It can also be done for those who have suffered mental breakdowns. This can also be done for changing evil habits. Besides, it can be done for the fulfillment of desired matters. It has been revealed that whatever the people wish for, it will yield results.

[GV3:P0720] Such a thing happens only very rarely across eons. It is informed that you will get an opportunity through this to correct it whenever a mistake happens in the divine decree. This will bestow upon you a portion of merit that never perishes in any era and an accumulation of wealth that never decays. Thinking that let whatever needs to come, come, and whatever needs to go, go, you must bravely carry this forward. Everything we do here has been made to be done by making us experience and believe it. All this is for you. You are the ones who need to nurture and sustain this in an organizational nature.

[GV3:P0721] Question: What is the reason for all four yugas having the same repetitive nature?

[GV3:P0722] Guru: This question arises because the tradition of Hinduism has become immeasurably old. Sanatana Dharma means the culture of the great souls who existed in their respective times. History explains that the cultures which came and went in the forms of Shaktheya, Shaiva, and Vaishnava tried to reform mankind to an extent. In between, the way some acharyas followed the religious lineage can also be seen. However, those who came that way do not belong to the lineage of the original Manu. In the lineage of Vaivasvata Manu, the original Manu of this Manvantara, precisely due to some flaws that occurred to an acharya named Sathyathranan who came at the end of the third Chaturyuga, he went towards selfishness, and hence the reign according to God's will did not happen. Sathyathranan's concept was like a theory of evolution. Therefore, in order to implement the will of Brahman, the Trimurti system was brought in during the seventh Chaturyuga.

[GV3:P0723] Question: Did the Trimurti system not exist before that?

[GV3:P0724] Guru: No. Manus are those who fulfill the ideas according to the will of Brahman regarding the growths and declines of the world up to a certain period. Through such fourteen Manvantaras, the origin, creation, sustenance, and dissolution of this world have been brought about.

[GV3:P0725] The nature of the soul according to the will of Brahman has also come about in this way.

[GV3:P0726] Question: Why is it that most people do not know that there is such a Manu lineage?

[GV3:P0727] Guru: As mentioned earlier, the feeling of "I" (Aham Brahmasmi) happened to the Manu lineage. In that ego, it was seen in the state of knowledge that all the acts of knowledge that had occurred in this world until then came through it. If you look at any Vedanta books, you can see this feeling of "I" standing out. You can see this independent feeling of "I" coming to the forefront if you speak to any ordinary person. When coming to the term Brahmachari, such feelings came through the Guru lineage. The deity I hold, or the goddess I hold in the lineage of deities, has more capability and glory. As a result of this coming to each individual, Chamundi, Yakshi, Pey, Marutha, Madan, and Mantramoorthi all became lords. This happened due to the ego and selfishness of each individual.

[GV3:P0728] Question: Why did it happen like this?

[GV3:P0729] Guru: As I said earlier, the Trimurti system was created by the command of the Brahma power when the will of Brahman did not materialize due to the ups and downs that occurred in the Manu lineage. Vedanta ceased to exist for this Trimurti system. Its nature became worship, prayer, and manifestation. When that nature changed to showing tests by making even Marutha dance, mankind was unable to fully see the glory of God or accurately know or study its measure, or the centers of knowledge.

[GV3:P0730] Question: If the Guru says so, doesn't it mean that nothing that has come so far is correct?

[GV3:P0731] Guru: Yes, what was said so far is that it is not correct.

[GV3:P0732] Question: You said that the Trimurti system was formed to execute the will of Brahman because the Manu lineage made a mistake, right?

[GV3:P0733] Guru: By bringing the varna-ashrama to the people who were worshiping in the Trimurti system in such a way that they could not act according to the merit of the time, caste and sub-castes were introduced into it. Prior to that, fabricated stories were created through sruti and smriti and made into authorities. Before that, empirical arguments came and some sannyasins themselves handled the siddhi systems. By the time it reached this point, the Manu system faded away even from memories. The current degradation is the result of not changing the systems that should be changed according to the change of time, and doing it with the vain idea that the position of Brahman should always remain in the hands of the Deva-Brahmins.

[GV3:P0734] Guru Vani

[GV3:P0737] Vow and Prayer

[GV3:P0738] It was hinted earlier that doing such a prayer here is according to an instruction. You must remember while doing this prayer, during this prayer time which rectifies the mistakes of a long time, if even a small scratch of ignorance enters your mind, it will spread. It will spread in many ways. We are doing the prayer to rectify the flaws that have occurred in all the actions of the householders, and similarly in all the actions of the sannyasins and brahmacharis. This is not a matter according to the capability of your mind. Therefore, some ignorance and mistakes may occur. There is nothing else to say other than that it is God's will making us do a special thing at a distance that no one can say. You should always think that may God give an opportunity for this Guru and the Guru lineage, which God has given us, to impart double the goodness after removing not only the shortcomings of mine and my ancestors that have occurred over time, but also the overall shortcomings of the people of the world. The children you raise and who are growing, and the children standing here having accepted sannyasa are equally participants in this noble karma. You must also think about how it should be done if a way of redemption is to come through the karma you all do together. You should always think, while doing any work, that if there have been shortcomings through sannyasins and their lineage, or through any parts of this world, all of them should be destroyed, and in that place, the goodness according to the will of Brahman should come through the Guru lineage. When studying children do not get knowledge in their mind, they should pray like this. You should pray that not only the children in this lineage, but wherever there are children who have gone astray, they all get goodness in this way.

[GV3:P0739] This is the word God told us. You should pay special attention to boys and girls separately and pray for them. The karma coming from me, who is a woman, should correct the mistake of the woman in this world. The man should also think the same way. That should be your qualification. This qualification of the man and the woman is advancing together here. At that time, our mind should not become bad or we should not fall into circumstances that make the mind bad. Especially the men and women growing here are the ones to make judgments for the world. We should become great through this sense of dharma. Standing in this dharma, our constant prayer is that all the mistakes that have traditionally occurred not only in this solar system but also in other solar systems should be resolved, and we should be given the knowledge, familiarity, and experience to do what we need when we need it. When we have that knowledge and God tells us and makes us do it, we should be ready to do it. Other than this, thoughts like rubbish lying on the road should not be allowed to enter the mind. If this prayer is done on a full moon day, it will yield full results.

[GV3:P0742] About forty years ago, a number of people came to know in a visible way about the experiences I had on a small scale. That was at Varkala. But after this continued for four years, I came here after being told not to sit in a way that two people could see. When I came here, this was the acquaintance I had. I had told those who have faith and love to bring something for me to eat. But as locals, they did not decrease it, they kept increasing it. You have misunderstood that this is sannyasa. None of this is sannyasa at all. Nor is it any karma from taking sannyasa. If you think so, it's a mistake. Till today, our posture of each one is by looking at these swamis who show these wonders. It is something that shouldn't be shown. Go truthfully, let what has to come, come. Let what doesn't have to come, not come.

To solve this mistake, God brought 2444 Gurus and Prophets within the last 5000 years. They could not achieve it. If God has chosen us to correct that mistake, or if God wishes to fulfill that karma through us, poor people who know nothing, how lucky each of you who are part of that karma are, how fortunate! How should we respect that power which informed this in advance? Even if we can act only for a moment, it must be done correctly. If done so, the result of that karma will remain here. No one will take it away. We should think about how to carry forward that underlying power of the soul.

[GV3:P1018] The path of Santhigiri is the decree of Brahman. It is this path of the decree of Brahman that is called Sanatana. You are praying to a name and form capable of fulfilling a special karma given by God to complete this karma. What do you see when you pray to this? How many karmic flaws ancestors brought through worship, how much it is spread in this world - from this little child to the mothers are seeing it.

[GV3:P1019] When you see this, you will have many kinds of pain. There will be no one to pamper you when you see this. Sometimes you will even get kicked and beaten. Still, you should have the confidence and knowledge that "I will do this". What was the need for Krishna's father and mother to sit in prison to give birth to Krishna? What did we turn Krishna into? This is the knowledge and experience gained from Hindu Dharma. This knowledge itself has continued for so long. If this is not changed, we will keep going towards a karma that destroys the world. Because of the mistake in this system, crores of souls are standing polluted in the atmosphere.

[GV3:P1020] A few years ago, a stone came down from the atmosphere. It exploded and fell into the sphere of Jupiter. It was not a stone. It was a meteor. Scientists initially thought it was coming to Earth. Just as it fell in the sphere of Jupiter, it is waiting to fall in other spheres as well. To cause such destruction, it circled for so many miles. Such a huge scene is waiting above us. This can happen in any part of this solar system. Then it will overturn all theories of Yuga Dharma. It is about this destroyer that Jesus gave us evidence. Saying, "Satan, go away". It didn't go. It continued until the cross. Similarly, this Satan destroyed all the great souls who came to date. The karmic flaw that came by theorizing this Satan is ruling us. Those who go to holy places dying in accidents, even Sanyasis fighting and dying making claims at festival places, and dying while stoning Satan, all fall within the specifics of devotion. In this way, many kinds of karmic flaws that end in death happen in the name of our theories. We must think about how we can change these karmic flaws. It is to change this that God is making us pray here. Therefore, while you pray, you should resolve that whatever karmic flaws have occurred in this world through the system of worship, they should change, and the souls that stand corrupted due to the flaws in worship should get rebirth or be destroyed.

[GV3:P1021] The daily prayer at Santhigiri is such a karma. God is making us do this service to the world. Brahma Muhurtha is an excellent circumstance for the true Dharma that we have prepared. Religious theories, Puranas, epics, and various kinds of theories have tried in many ways to convince about the things that came through the system of worship where mistakes occurred for so many Yugas. All these attempts are their intellectual exercises. If one tries to complete God using literacy, will it be helpful for the execution of Brahman's decree? You must think about this.

[GV3:P1024] The story of the pain of many great souls

[GV3:P1025] You are educated, knowledgeable, and intelligent. Those of you who stand near me and those who come to stay here with me should know at least this much. Why do you come and stay here, or what is the purpose of your staying here? You must fully accomplish that purpose. Otherwise, each of you will move away. Even if you have knowledge, it will happen so due to your lack of wisdom.

[GV3:P1026] How much have you lost here? If I had arranged a management and made them do this, would this much loss have occurred? It is only after seeing where your flaw is that this organization has been entrusted to you. But if you decide yourself that you will not improve, what can I do? There is no question whether you are a man or a woman, young or old, if you act knowingly, there will be no shortcoming here, no trouble will happen. If someone takes an item, at least you should be able to tell the one who took it to put it back. But for you, even if it is thrown into any dung pit, will you feel pain?

[GV3:P1027] I did not call you here by troubling you. I did not call you here and ruin you. I gave you all the freedom to act as if it is your own property. What is your wish, just do that. I didn't look whether you are old people, people with a tradition, or new people. To me, old and new are all the same. You shouldn't stay near me thinking that I have some kind of partiality everywhere. If you think so, I will move away from you.

[GV3:P1028] You don't have to do any work that brings you hardship and loss. Then, if you don't look after what is entrusted to you, those who don't look after it will be removed and someone else will be placed. Has anything been done here that makes it difficult for you to stand together and maintain things in any way? If one acts properly, another cannot act improperly. This organization, the karma here - you think whether it is needed or not. A person had a difficulty. He told it to the committee members. The committee members must resolve it. I should resolve it only if you cannot.

[GV3:P1029] You have learned the respective aspects that you have become familiar with. If you copy what you have learned here, it will not be right. What you saw and knew until yesterday is right indeed. You got that much familiarity, didn't you? But you must also understand that you have a shortcoming and that God has given an opportunity to think about that shortcoming. My sorrow is that you are becoming incapable of utilizing that opportunity.

[GV3:P1030] For crores of years, God brought this historical truth in many forms through the systems of prophets, the systems of Devas, and the systems of Rishis. Each system has been brought in each nature and in many familiarities. Similarly, independent paths like Jain and Buddha have spread in many ways. After Sree Krishna, crores of great souls have come. It's just that none of it has come out. Therefore, we don't have information about them. If you do not consider this as an opportunity given by God for us who are alive and for our ancestors to change the disasters that have occurred since ancient times, you will fail. This is my sorrow.

[GV3:P1031] This is not a continuation of any other idea. We are doing the karma of taking everything good from what has come so far and preserving what is to come without flaws. The mistakes of what exists today cannot be changed suddenly. Human life is a truth where mistakes have to be corrected over many generations. Because life is a truth where right and wrong are mixed, spread across generations. Without knowing any of this, one is rushing to live somehow according to what is seen. The lives of those with great wealth and riches are no different. Each one is handling life as if they hold some greatness in their hands. What I have to say is that one should not destroy the goodness of one's own life by showing arrogance with money and wealth.

[GV3:P1032] Our younger generation is self-destructing their karma and losing their culture due to some special tendencies that have come. That is why distorted tendencies are passed on. The elders are eager to nourish it. They are becoming independent, having nothing to say to anyone. Freedom is not something to say anything and do anything.

[GV3:P1033] As far as we are concerned, this is not freedom. Create a karma capable of changing the mistake that happened to us and what currently exists. This is the freedom we need. Without the freedom for that, this mistake cannot be changed. Then, in the place where that mistake is changed, the freedom to give something to the people, the freedom to acquire the knowledge for it. Today we have the freedom to create knowledge in that way. You should consider this as the time permitted by God for that.

[GV3:P1034] You shouldn't come here with the intention of achieving some temporary peace like going everywhere else. Whatever you can get, you may earn it. As a special thing from all that, you have a hymn from God to get from here. How to master this; this is what those standing here and coming here should know first. For that, you shouldn't act stubbornly and show this and that. It is not haste that is needed for this. Because this is not something to tie up tomorrow and find a reason to quarrel. You only have the knowledge to quarrel like that.

[GV3:P1035] What I am telling is my familiarity and experience. I am telling a knowledge I learned through pain since my fourteenth year. You shouldn't think that I am telling about something where I lived happily in some way. Have you understood what is in my possession? It is a matter where many great souls came and suffered.

[GV3:P1036] What have you learned? Our Swami is great, your Swami is small. That Swami then became God. Then it became the God of our caste. What I am saying is, you shouldn't come here for the matter of playing God in caste and becoming bad. There is no matter here to play God like that. If God is there, He is there, if not, He is not. You don't have to say and establish it. It is enough if you accept this to the extent of your experience. You are learning this here for the first time in human history. This cannot be learned by taking any course. There is no such method here. You should desire to take this only by suffering, going through pain, and finding joy in that pain. No matter how much you suffer, no fault will come. The more you suffer, the more joy you will get. You should behave here only in this idea. You shouldn't try to lift this up today and tomorrow to improve or ruin anyone. It is enough if you do this on behalf of God. Do what you can. Nothing more is needed. We don't know anything, we didn't come knowing anything, we are happy with those who know, we have fulfillment in working together with them - it is enough if you have such humility. Don't say or do anything stubbornly. That will be wrong. This is not going to happen with the greatness of doing things stubbornly. What is done without humility will become the mold of ignorance created without honesty. What is there to evaluate and know in a karma lacking humility and honesty?

[GV3:P1037] There are some specialties where karma is advised to one person's intellect, mixed with another person's deceit and betrayal, entrusted to us, and operated through us. If you can do something for the good without falling and rotting in that, do it.

[GV3:P1038] Be complete in karma done with patience. Everyone should be able to love you seeing your actions. Nobody should feel like leaving you and running away seeing your actions. You shouldn't go into such karma. How much greatness and depth love can be brought to - karma is for this.

[GV3:P1039] All present organizations are organizations of caste and religion. All of them are standing ready to fight based on class division. Here you shouldn't prepare for anything in that state; don't do anything.

[GV3:P1040] If not done, then not done, that's all. Don't grasp the aspect where you and others become bad by doing it. Businesses among the people, agricultural matters - the capability of functioning in these, culture, the basic aspect of survival, in which parts there is no knowledge; how much of this matter they can absorb and accept - you should act in him only taking all this into account. Otherwise, you and he will fall into danger.

[GV3:P1041] Nowadays, the fighting spirit among political, religious, and caste organizations is very high. Everyone acts like they are the great ones, with no ordinary people left. The familiarity of such stubborn actions resides within you as well. Do not prepare to act and complete things based on that habit. We are none of this. What we must do first is to take responsibility for the mistakes committed by our ancestors. When taking up that mistake, there will be a corresponding determination and detachment (vairagyam) for it. When we say vairagyam, it is not the vengeance to beat and destroy others. Vairagyam is a great density of tolerance endured with love. Each of us should have the karmic ability to act with such detachment.

[GV3:P1042] The girls in our homes will not stay with us for very long. Once they grow up, there is an anxiety to somehow send them away from the house. Whether it is a big house or a small house, the worry is to get the girl out of the house. And what if she is sent away? She has to adapt to the struggles there. Otherwise, she will come back home. Or else, she might even be killed. Parents are struggling through this, caught in a lineage entangled in all these issues. You should not show any such fuss. Let things happen as they naturally should in the world. There are some mischievous people who make a big deal out of all these noises. They think they are the greatest in the world. Nobody can simply become great or small like that. This is because this is a kind of nature developed from the circumstances in which humans have lived. Other than the fact that it has reached us too, no one on earth exists with only happiness. This is the result of the defects that have come into our past karmas.

[GV3:P1043] What is the root cause of this defect? To what extent can we free ourselves from it? We have acquired restlessness from the influence of wandering ancestors, gods and goddesses, and many such evil karmic forces. Even today, we are unknowingly acquiring restlessness. And what is the action we are doing here? We are growing by making efforts to find a way for peace from all this. How much determination can we attain in this action—this is the thought we should have today and always. Do not think of anything else. There is no time for all that in this short life. Let those who are stubborn in caste and politics compete, think, and win in that path. We do not need to give much respect and importance to those foolish words.

[GV3:P1044] Instead of arguing for someone else, isn't it better to be determined for your own good? Is there a need for both you and others to be destroyed together by being stubborn about correcting others? When you act on your own and that pain reaches the karma, you and those who suffer with you must ensure that the karma is not destroyed.

[GV3:P1045] Keeping what someone else earned in the past as one's own is called 'Pandarappattam'. Is what has been converted into one's own property in this way the only thing that belongs to me? No, you should become completely firm in the actions you have to do on your own. Otherwise, you will have nothing to call your own. Coming, staying, and acting here should be for that purpose. Not to show off one's greatness. If you show off your greatness, your children will show off even more.

[GV3:P1046] Education is essential for you. But the education that exists today is not enough. It is not an education suitable for the nature and culture of India. India had wealth, prosperity, name, and fame, right? How did it go away? Where are the seeds of India's destruction sown? If we learn things from somewhere else and piece them together without learning in a way suitable for India's culture, it means you are working to copy their greatness. It is not an action for your own betterment. If you do not have the knowledge to grasp and carry things forward yourself, you cannot even imagine the danger that is going to happen.

[GV3:P1047] What I have to show you in this matter is an experience of a very long time. When I say an experience of a long time, it doesn't mean just the long time I have lived. It means taking up the karmic energy of great souls who have come over many ages. And their sorrow too.

[GV3:P1049] October 2000

[GV3:P1050] If we find the boundaries of a god or goddess or their retinues, how much have we really seen? In truth, this is nothing at all. At the very least, considering the visionary tradition of the past five thousand years, one should be able to unify a Guru, an Acharya, or a Prophet who came within it and move forward. Not a single religious theorist has been able to do this. We haven't even had the time to think about these things. Even if we had the time, we wouldn't be able to think like that. No one has thought beyond what Mahatmaji did. After that, it was Narayana Guru who thought more. Let us say we adopted a path like that of Sri Ramakrishna, Vivekananda, or Shankaracharya. How would we know which of these is right and which is wrong? Everything is in such disarray that it cannot be known.

[GV3:P1051] A girl we raise becomes a mother. That girl should be able to preserve her own culture and an understanding of the country's progress. Who is working to raise her in that manner? Everyone is like a machine facing west. Other than singing what we learned and passing exams, what do we have of our own? If we are not looking west, we are interested in looking north. According to their logic, the tradition of Hindus lies in the north. Another section belongs to the Dakshinamurti faction. Because things got ruined in this way, we could not progress in any way.

[GV3:P1052] Narayana Guru Swami has expressed sorrow over not having a child. The meaning of this is not as uncles say. For example, Nataraja Guru was someone Swami nurtured. Nataraja Guru could not carry forward that idea. Following that, not a single educated person even looked back at it. Everyone went after bookish knowledge by studying Vedanta. Advaita is great, Dvaita is small - if each such argument is made big and small, will the ideas or theories obtained through hardship be correct?

[GV3:P1053] What is meant is that the successors could not do it. Nobody could adapt to and act according to that idea. There is no other field that acted as wrongly as the successors of Narayana Guru. The householders of India have never engaged in a karma of thinking about, growing in, and nurturing their swadharma as householders. One section completed it by speaking of Varnasrama dharma. Another section completed it by speaking of the Vedic religion. This is the logic of the Hindu. The logic of Christians and Muslims is no different. There has not been a single logic that is equally useful to all people. How can we overcome this shortcoming?

[GV3:P1054] We are starting from where all the Acharyas who came and went had stopped. In the last five thousand years, about twenty-five Acharyas like Jesus and Moses came. Over two thousand Gurus came among the Hindus. Around two hundred and fifty individual Gurus, like the Parayi petta panthirukulam and the eighteen Siddhars, came. Their contemporaries did not allow anyone to do anything. Sikh Gurus were killed by being thrown into roasting sand. Sri Krishna was not even allowed to stay in this land. How did this destined karma come upon all of them, making them unable to execute the Divine Will? You must consider whether their actions stood in goodness or went astray.

[GV3:P1055] Whatever kinds of defects there might have been, India is a land enriched by the birth of sages. How did such a land of India end up with such a misguided karmic path? All the Acharyas were those who endured sacrifices to improve humanity in every way. But how much goodness could we extract from their sacrifices? From what states did they operate? What were the transitions they went through? What were they able to achieve? What did they do before leaving? Only those with wisdom can evaluate their actions as having set the stage for a great sorrow.

[GV3:P1056] Kali Yuga is the shortest period among the yugas. Various people speak of the length of the Kali Yuga in different ways. Some say five thousand years, others say four lakh thirty-two thousand years. There are also those who state a length between these two. Whatever the different time calculations regarding the length may be, the scenario presented to convince people that Kali is not good is not true. Is Kali really bad? When we look at all the different types of freedoms and rights humanity has gained in this yuga, Kali is never bad; it is the best. The reason Kali is called bad is because the dharma of Kali is not being practiced.

[GV3:P1057] If the respective dharmas were practiced in Treta Yuga and Dvapara Yuga, and similarly if its dharma was practiced in Satya Yuga, shouldn't its dharma be practiced in Kali Yuga? It is because people did not know how to practice it that they declared Kali as destructive. Countless chaturyugas, more than one can count in a lifetime, have passed without practicing Kali. Our lifespan is such a short period that we cannot determine a chaturyuga in any way. Therefore, we are not capable of fulfilling the Yuga Dharma. Due to this reason, the weakness that has come upon us for a long time continues to afflict us. This affects not only India but the entire world.

[GV3:P1058] Now let us look at the births of great souls. It was mentioned earlier that there are about twenty-five notable births in Islam and Christianity. How many sacrifices they have made for humanity! When we look at how many succeeded in implementing the Divine Will among them, it is not difficult for us to see that there is no one. The truth remains that the Yadava clan could not reap the fortune brought by the birth of Sri Krishna. Therefore, despite having around two thousand sages, yogis, and ascetics in India following Sri Krishna's birth, what all harms have befallen India! In Kerala alone, two or three great figures including Shankaracharya, and in other parts Jain and Buddha came, and they too got caught up in the extended stories of scholars. Because of all this, we suffered massive defeats. The reason for those defeats is that we did not become strong enough to internalize and act upon the teachings of these great ones.

[GV3:P1059] We must start only from where these great souls stopped. Otherwise, we will just keep counting these defeats one by one and lie there. What purpose do we achieve by counting like that? Nothing. We must rely on the Guru who points out these mistakes. We must believe in such a Guru. If a thousand people believe like that, a true visionary aspect will be useful for only four or five people. Thus, out of a lakh people who might benefit from the vision, there will not be more than five who can be selected. Through these five, it will be revealed what we can achieve through this Guru in the light of all the Gurus who have come so far. That Guru is the seat of permanent peace for humanity.

[GV3:P1060] A Vyazhavattam (Jovian cycle) is twelve years. This is the calculation of the rotation of the Earth, Sun, Moon - all nine planets. We can never take up the karmic path that has spun like this through ages. However, the experience here is that if the Guru is entirely capable, the vision of the great predecessors can be obtained through that Guru. These great souls will come in the light of this Guru and show the path. This is the complete proof that this Guru is entirely capable. How will such a Guru be useful in our lives? Even if useful, how will we accept it? Reach the path of this Guru in a way that gives liberation to everything that was worshipped ancestrally. This is success in life. After granting liberation, the Guru’s dharma is to take the karmic path that is mixed as gross, subtle, causal, and effect, and correct it for the disciple. This is the dharma of the Guru. Only the Guru who falls within that dharma is eternal peace. Completion of Vedanta, logical arguments, and debates are not going to be useful to us. We are not going to gain anything either.

[GV3:P1061] There is vision in all religions. We also have a karmic path to perceive in what ways it exists. However, what we need to know is what weaknesses exist in the paths where predecessors were accepted in vision, yoga, devotion, and the path of action. The Guru who points out the remedy for that weakness to the disciple will make the disciple perform this remedy himself. It is not the Guru who should perform the remedy. Even if the Guru does it, it is only to correct the mistakes that might have occurred in the disciple's karma. Otherwise, the Guru must not do the action that the disciple is capable of doing. Because, if the Guru does it, that action will cease with the Guru's time. The karmic path lived out by the disciple for that purpose is the perfection of sacrifice. Learning and teaching the glories of that sacrifice is the true Guru-disciple relationship. The biggest matter is how much we have achieved in such a Guru-disciple relationship. Simply repeating, learning, and teaching what the Guru showed does not make a true Guru-disciple relationship. Bringing a disciple to this level is the Guru's sense of duty. This era, which has been fully granted to this lineage for this sense of duty, is the best indeed.
